name: Croatia
snapshot: A tourism-driven euro member where the conservative HDZ governs with nationalist partners, while the president, Zoran Milanović, plays a combative opposition role.
culture: Croatia's Adriatic coast, Dubrovnik's walls and Split's Roman palace draw millions of visitors. Catholicism and the memory of the 1991 to 1995 independence war shape national identity. The national football team's run to the 2018 World Cup final and third place in 2022 are huge sources of pride. Klapa a cappella singing is UNESCO-listed.
society: Tourism is about a fifth of the economy. Croatia joined the euro and Schengen in 2023. Emigration of young people to Germany and Ireland has shrunk the population, and labour shortages are filled by workers from Asia. Debates over the legacy of the Ustaša wartime regime still flare.
baseline: Andrej Plenković's HDZ formed a coalition with the nationalist Homeland Movement after the 2024 election. Zoran Milanović, a former Social Democrat prime minister, won re-election as president in January 2025 by a landslide and has clashed with the government over Ukraine and NATO.
